Comparing the before and after photos, item by item:

- **Orange juice:** about 250 ml at the start, about 200 ml left, so about 50 ml drunk (≈22 kcal).
- **Water:** some was drunk, but it has no energy, so it counts toward mass only (≈50 g).
- **Chocolate milk:** about 100 ml at the start, about 80 ml left, so about 20 ml drunk (≈15 kcal).
- **Rice/stuffing:** some was eaten and some egg is visible on the plate; I estimate 60 g eaten (≈90 kcal).
- **Turkey:** about 100 g at the start and some remains; I estimate 50 g eaten (≈75 kcal).
- **Potatoes:** two at the start, one smaller one left, so about 40 g eaten (≈35 kcal).
- **Vegetables:** about 30 g eaten (≈8 kcal).
- **Salad:** the tomatoes and cucumber were eaten, about 40 g (≈15 kcal including dressing).
- **Spinach lasagna:** roughly the same amount remains, so about 30 g eaten (≈40 kcal).
- **Other lasagna:** about 30 g eaten (≈45 kcal).
- **Brownie:** appears untouched.

Total is roughly 350 kcal and 400 g.
